jrandolf opened issue #14844:

This tracks what's left before the component model map<K, V> type can be enabled by default, following the discussion on #14801.

Runtime

  • [ ] #14810: map lifting allocates before validating the length (#14835)
  • [ ] #14812: duplicate keys leak handles
  • [ ] #14832: typed support is limited to HashMap with the default hasher

bindgen!

  • [ ] #14813: no codegen tests (#14834)
  • [ ] #14830: generated code doesn't compile without std (#14837)
  • [ ] #14831: anonymous map parameters are taken by value (#14838)
  • [ ] map contents are logged in non-verbose tracing (#14836)

CLI / WAVE

  • [ ] #14811: --invoke doesn't support maps (stopgap #14843; full support needs bytecodealliance/wasm-tools#2777, see also bytecodealliance/wasm-tools#2778)

Testing

  • [ ] #14833: fuzzing gaps
  • [ ] validation tests for map key types (#14841)
  • [ ] C API value tests (#14840)

Docs

  • [ ] Val::Map docs and Type::unwrap_map (#14839)
  • [ ] update docs/stability-wasm-proposals.md once the above are resolved

jrandolf edited issue #14844:

This tracks what's left before the component model map<K, V> type can be enabled by default, following the discussion on #14801.

Runtime

  • [x] #14810: map lifting allocates before validating the length (#14835)
  • [ ] #14812: duplicate keys leak handles. Handles are to be forbidden in map values instead (WebAssembly/component-model#751), which needs a wasm-tools release with that validation.
  • [x] #14832: typed support is limited to HashMap with the default hasher (#14870, #14927)

bindgen!

  • [x] #14813: no codegen tests (#14834)
  • [x] #14830: generated code doesn't compile without std (#14927)
  • [x] #14831: anonymous map parameters are taken by value (#14838)
  • [x] map contents are logged in non-verbose tracing (#14836)

CLI / WAVE

  • [ ] #14811: --invoke doesn't support maps (#14843, needs a wasm-tools release with bytecodealliance/wasm-tools#2782)

Testing

  • [x] #14833: fuzzing gaps (existing fuzzing is enough)
  • [x] validation tests for map key types (#14841)
  • [x] C API value tests (#14840)
  • [ ] map values in *.wast tests, for duplicate keys (#14843)

Docs

  • [x] Val::Map docs and Type::unwrap_map (#14839)
  • [ ] update docs/stability-wasm-proposals.md (#14801)
